evidence_against.relevance: Casey initiated contact in most weeks and consistently arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner show effort and responsiveness.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods apart, indicating sustained interest.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it.
The location and short notice of most meetings, plus two cancellations for other commitments, indicate convenience and limited prioritization.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could state the level of commitment and planning desired, ask whether Casey is willing to move toward it, and set a boundary if Casey remains unwilling to clarify.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's regular initiation, practical support, and renewed contact support meaningful interest, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-oriented meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement.
